source.description: A hulking colossus built from interlocked ribcages, skulls and fused femur arms, glowing sickly green between the bones, looming and swaying heavily, loose bones rattling and shifting. Seamless loop.

The bone colossus with fused femur arms attacks — it rears back with a rattling shudder, then sweeps a massive bone-shard claw toward the camera in a wide crushing arc, then settles back into its looming sway.

_notes: v3 humanoid character, south direction only. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
